summary: Frontend-only test of two new behaviors on /repairs service dialog: (1) multi-technician picker with chips, (2) sparepart merge-and-sum. Both features work correctly end-to-end including save, table display with joined technician names, edit-restore of chips & merged parts, and backward compatibility logic in openEdit. Note: seeded technicians are SATRIA/FAOZAN/FEBRI (not Budi/Agus as mentioned in the request).
test_scenarios_verified: Admin login works and /repairs loads with add-service-button visible
Opening dialog and picking a machine works
Selecting a technician adds a tech-chip-<id> with remove-tech-<id> remove button
Already-selected technician is filtered out of the dropdown options (verified: after selecting SATRIA, dropdown only shows FAOZAN, FEBRI)
Adding a second different technician creates a second chip (2 chips total)
Removing a chip reduces chip count by 1 and the technician reappears as a dropdown option
Sparepart merge: same sparepart added twice (qty 2 then qty 3) produces a single row 'CONVEYOR × 5' (merged qty = 5)
Adding a DIFFERENT sparepart creates a separate row (2 rows total)
Save with 2 technicians persists, services table 'Teknisi' column shows joined names 'FAOZAN, SATRIA'
Edit of saved service restores 2 technician chips and merged used_part '× 5' correctly
Backward compat path exercised via openEdit (technicians list falls back to [{id: technician_id, name: technician_name}] when technicians[] empty)
Delete of test service record works for cleanup
critical_code_review_comments: Repairs.js save() sets technician_id = techList[0]?.id or '' and technician_name = joined names — OK for backward compatibility but technician_id now only reflects first technician which is a minor inconsistency; acceptable per request.

File size of Repairs.js is approaching 400 lines; still within guideline (<700) but is dense. Could be split into smaller components (ServiceDialog, TechnicianPicker, SparepartPicker) for maintainability.
addPart converts qty via Number(partQty) || 1 — if user types 0 it becomes 1 silently; minor UX quirk.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary service record with 2 technicians and merged CONVEYOR x5 part; deleted via UI during cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded technicians are SATRIA, FAOZAN, FEBRI (not Budi Santoso/Agus Setiawan per the request). The technician and sparepart selects are Radix comboboxes — use page.click on the trigger then page.get_by_role('option', name=..., exact=True).click(force=True). Service table has many existing rows (90+); when verifying a saved record, filter rows by content containing both technician names.
